question: How should the portions of Hari and Brahmā and others be arranged in the image?
premises: Half of Hari is described in this manner.
A portion of Brahmā and others is included.
The arrangement is to be performed accordingly.
inference: One should arrange the half of Hari and the portion of Brahmā and others in this way.
plain_english: Thus one should fashion the half of Hari and likewise the portion of Brahmā and others.
